title: RepoProfileApproved
description: The architect approved a version of a repo's profile through its rule brief; from now on HOTL works on the repo with it (ADR 0013). Topic hotl.rule; subject and key: the repo. Producer: Review service. Main consumers: Knowledge graph; intake, the agent runtime and the CI/CD adapter read profiles from the review service.

version.description: The profile version now in effect.

attachment.description: The attachment that proposed it, for example ATT-0001.
